description: ChatGPT/Claude-style session management with conversation history, folders, search, and per-chat settings.

architectureNotes: SessionList replaces or wraps ChatSidebar with grouped conversation history (Today, Yesterday, etc.).
SessionFolders provides a collapsible folder tree for organizing conversations.
ChatHeader adds inline title editing, model selection, temperature/system-prompt config, and share/export.
Wire session CRUD to your database — each session stores title, messages, folder assignment, pinned/archived state.
Search filters across session titles and message content server-side.
